deals.travelWindow: Feb 13 – Apr 24, 2027 (new Allegiant route; intro one-way from $49)
deals.whyRanked: Still the cheapest verified fare (~$98 RT from Allegiant's Nov launch pricing, carried over from earlier digests; verify); Canaveral National Seashore is ~50 min away.
deals.soloWhy: Cheap and easy with a rental car, but SFB is outside Orlando proper; best for beach and springs days rather than nightlife.

highlights: Canaveral National Seashore: Playalinda Beach and Turtle Mound
Wekiwa Springs: swim or paddle the 72°F spring
Merritt Island NWR Black Point Wildlife Drive for birds and manatees
Winter Park Scenic Boat Tour and Park Avenue
itinerary: Day 1 — Land at SFB, drive to Wekiwa Springs for a paddle, evening in Winter Park
Day 2 — Black Point Wildlife Drive at Merritt Island, then Playalinda Beach at sunset
Day 3 — Slow morning in downtown Sanford on the Riverwalk, fly out
guide.gettingAround: Rent a car; SFB has limited transit and the seashore has no public transport.
guide.stayArea: Downtown Sanford (walkable riverfront, cheap) or Winter Park for more dining.
food: Tomoka-area fish camps for fresh Gulf-style seafood

deals.whyRanked: Southwest lists $79 one-way Basic (RT estimated ~2x; verify); Fort McHenry and Patapsco Valley SP are close, DC is a train ride away.
deals.soloWhy: Walkable harbor neighborhoods, cheap eats, and MARC/Amtrak make Washington an easy day trip.

highlights: Fort McHenry, birthplace of the national anthem
Lexington Market and the Walters Art Museum (free)
itinerary: Day 1 — Inner Harbor, Fell's Point, Canton waterfront
Day 2 — Fort McHenry morning, Walters Art Museum, Hampden
Day 3 — Patapsco hike or MARC train to DC, depart
guide.gettingAround: Light rail runs BWI to downtown; the free Charm City Circulator and water taxi cover the core.
guide.stayArea: Fell's Point or Federal Hill for walkable food and nightlife.

deals.whyRanked: Southwest lists $100 one-way Basic for Jan 6 (RT estimated ~2x; verify); Timucuan Preserve and Amelia Island are close.
deals.soloWhy: Beaches and parks are great solo, though the city is spread out and car-dependent.

highlights: Fort Caroline and Kingsley Plantation in Timucuan Preserve
itinerary: Day 1 — Riverside Arts Market area, Five Points, Riverwalk
Day 2 — Kingsley Plantation, Boneyard Beach, Fernandina Beach
guide.gettingAround: Rent a car; downtown has the Skyway but little else.
guide.stayArea: Riverside/Avondale for walkable food and bars.

deals.whyRanked: Southwest lists $100 one-way Basic (RT estimated ~2x; verify); Canaveral National Seashore ~1 h and Wekiwa Springs ~35 min away.
deals.soloWhy: Easy nonstop and plenty of lodging, but best outside the theme parks with a rental car.

itinerary: Day 1 — Lake Eola, Thornton Park, Mills 50 dinner
Day 2 — Wekiwa Springs paddle, Winter Park boat tour
Day 3 — Apollo Beach at Canaveral, depart
guide.gettingAround: Rent a car for springs and beaches; SunRail covers downtown to Winter Park.
guide.stayArea: Thornton Park or Mills 50 for walkable food.

deals.whyRanked: Southwest lists $110 one-way Basic (RT estimated ~2x; verify); Huntington Beach SP and Waccamaw wildlife refuge are close.
deals.soloWhy: Quiet, cheap off-season beaches and boardwalk; car needed for the best nature stops.

highlights: Huntington Beach SP's Atalaya Castle and marsh boardwalk
itinerary: Day 1 — Boardwalk and beach, Myrtle Beach SP
Day 2 — Huntington Beach SP and Brookgreen Gardens
Day 3 — Murrells Inlet MarshWalk brunch, depart
guide.gettingAround: Rent a car; transit is minimal.
guide.stayArea: Near Myrtle Beach SP or Murrells Inlet for quieter off-season stays.
